## Checklist

- [ ] Linked issue
- [ ] `go vet ./...` is clean, `go test -race ./...` passes, `golangci-lint run` is clean
- [ ] A new or changed rule has an `analysistest` case in `testdata/`
- [ ] The behaviour difference is cited (release notes, proposal or source)
- [ ] The title is `type: summary`
